issues.title: Make GitHub issues dispatchable with the model line preselected
issues.body:
## Goal

Pick an issue in the launcher and have the model, effort and permissions filled in from its model line.

## Who should do it

- Claude: `claude --model sonnet --effort medium --permission-mode acceptEdits`
- Codex: `codex -m gpt-5.6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort="medium" -s workspace-write -a on-request`
- Why this tier: a normal feature across backend and launcher.
